_readme: AI Creative Lab gallery. To add work: put videos in assets/lab/videos/ and images in assets/lab/images/ (optional poster images in assets/lab/posters/), then add an entry to `items`. categories: any of "AI Videos", "Animation", "AI Art", "Experiments". type: "video" or "image". Optional fields: poster, aspect ("16:9" | "9:16" | "1:1"), tools, link, linkLabel, duration, language, featured. Leave unknown fields out; they are hidden, never guessed.

items.title: Blur → Blast: Game Over
items.description: A game-style recap of Blur and Blast: $2.3B deposited before the chain was even live, the points-fuelled boom, a $62M exploit, and TVL down 97% from the peak. Two products that ran on rewards, and went quiet when the rewards stopped.

items.title: 3D Mascot Rubik Film: The Unsolvable Cube
items.description: A 3D toy-style mascot short built with headless Blender 4.5, GSAP motion planning, and Remotion: a talking chat-bubble intro, physically lit 3D Rubik's cube choreography, procedural SFX, and a voice-cloned call-to-action.

items.title: 3D FPS Tactical Drone Showcase: Ruined Hall
items.description: A procedural 3D first-person tactical showcase: tracking autonomous quadcopter drones through sunlit ancient stone ruins with custom HUD telemetry, scope optics, and camera recoil choreography.

items.title: How Google Invented the 'T' in ChatGPT
items.description: A 7-scene cinematic 2D stickman documentary on the 2017 'Attention Is All You Need' paper: why RNNs hit a wall, how 8 Google Brain researchers invented the Transformer, and the irony of OpenAI turning Google's open-source breakthrough into ChatGPT.

items.title: SBF's $500M Anthropic Bet
items.description: In 2021, Sam Bankman-Fried wired $500M from Alameda Research into a little-known AI lab called Anthropic. After FTX collapsed, that single stake became worth $1.4B—enough to help make FTX creditors whole.

items.title: OpenAI: From Non-Profit to $150B Giant
items.description: A 9-scene vertical documentary tracing OpenAI from its December 2015 non-profit founding dinner, the Dota 2 OpenAI Five milestone, and the 2019 capped-profit pivot to Microsoft's multi-billion dollar compute alliance.

items.title: How Airplane Vacuum Toilets Actually Work
items.description: A procedural 3D cutaway explainer rendered in headless Blender 4.5 Cycles/EEVEE and edited in Remotion: how James Kemper's 1975 vacuum valve uses cabin-to-sky pressure differential instead of heavy water pumps at 35,000 feet.

items.title: 6 Claude AI Prompting Rules That Actually Work
items.description: A fast-paced vertical reel breaking down 6 practical prompting techniques for Claude: explain-like-I'm-10 framing, role assignment, ask-before-answering, structured output formats, and interactive Artifacts.

items.title: Grok Bot: It Works While I Sleep
items.description: An intro to Grok Bot: what it can and can’t do, its Canva, Figma, and Google Slides skills, roughly what it costs, and how it moved my work from creator to editor.

items.title: Got X Premium+? Make Videos with Grok Bot
items.description: A step-by-step tutorial for making videos with Grok Bot: open x.ai/bot, write a clear prompt (topic, language, length, style), review drafts until they feel right, render, and add an ElevenLabs voiceover safely. Start small, stay consistent.

items.title: XPass: Everything in One Subscription?
items.description: A case-file breakdown of a rumoured X subscription bundle: four leaked tiers from Plus to Ultra, the Grok and AI features in each, and what happens to existing Premium and SuperGrok plans. Rumour, not official.

items.title: Cold DMs: Then vs. Now
items.description: How cold DMs to founders opened doors for me in 2023, before AI, how the same approach still works today with Dirol on Monad, and how AI now does the heavy lifting. AI writes faster, but the DM still needs to be you.

items.title: HelloTrade: Meet the Team
items.description: An animated intro to HelloTrade on Monad: founders who helped launch BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF (IBIT), advisors including Arthur Hayes, Josh Lim, and Larry Florio, and a mission to make global capital markets accessible to everyone.

items.title: Moncock: A Rooster on Monad
items.description: A fight-card style breakdown of $MONCOCK, a Monad memecoin built around a community mascot: the origin story, why it’s so memeable, the tale of the tape, and a possible catalyst. Education, not financial advice; disclosure included in the video.

items.title: Bitget Masih SAFU?
items.description: A Bahasa Indonesia explainer after a hack scare: Bitget’s staged withdrawal schedule for BTC, ETH, and USDT, a real test trade, the big-picture withdrawal numbers, and the lessons: don’t panic, check official info, and do your own research.

items.title: What Even Is Dirol?
items.description: A 10-part explainer on Dirol, a social trading app on Monad: swaps, charts, limit orders, and new tokens in one app, one-click non-custodial trading, spot and perps, and how to join the whitelist. Education, not financial advice.

items.title: Dirol Itu Apa Sih?
items.description: The Bahasa Indonesia version of the Dirol explainer: a social trading app on Monad with swaps, charts, limit orders, one-click non-custodial trading, spot and perps, and how to join the whitelist. Education, not financial advice.

items.title: The Mutual Fun
items.description: A short look at The Mutual Fun on Robinhood Chain: five on-chain funds run by the people who hold them, no owner and no upgrade path, and how to apply for a soulbound TMF Pass.

items.title: The Mutual Fun: Mutuals
items.description: A cinematic follow-up on The Mutual Fun’s Mutuals desk: swipe-style applications, a 72-hour window for pass holders, and a system built on working together.

items.title: botdirectory.ai: Ready-to-Copy Grok Bot Prompts
items.description: A quick discovery video on botdirectory.ai: a public, open-source directory of hundreds of ready-to-copy Grok Bot prompts for marketing, sales, productivity, ops, and more. Browse, copy, launch.

items.title: Revenge Trade: Abis Fumble, Pengen Bales Dendam?
items.description: A Bahasa Indonesia trading-psychology explainer: what revenge trading is (emotion, not setup), a personal overtrading story, why stopping and sleeping was the right call, and the lesson. Education, not financial advice.

items.title: Make Videos with Grok CLI + Remotion
items.description: A beginner tutorial on making videos with an AI coding agent: install Grok CLI, open a terminal, add the Remotion skill, prompt clearly, and render straight to MP4. No design degree needed.

items.title: Apa itu Bagworking? Crypto Memecoin
items.description: An animated explainer in Bahasa Indonesia on bagworking in memecoin communities: what a bag is, what bag workers actually do (content, replies, raids, community, narrative), and the risks. Work does not guarantee a pump.

items.title: Apa itu NFT? Panduan Pemula
items.description: A beginner's guide to NFTs in Bahasa Indonesia: fungible vs. non-fungible, NFTs as unique digital certificates on the blockchain, what they're used for, and how mint, wallet, trade, and on-chain records fit together.

items.title: Jensen Huang & Taruhan Terbesar NVIDIA (3D Mascot Edition)
items.description: How Jensen Huang nearly went bankrupt in 1996 before betting NVIDIA's future on CUDA and AI compute—narrated with a 3D toy mascot intro and cinematic documentary scenes.

items.title: AI Chat vs. CLI Agent: Bedanya Apa? (Bersama Rubik)
items.description: Why browser AI chat only gives advice while a CLI coding agent goes straight into your folders to edit files, run commands, and ship projects—hosted by the 3D Rubik cat mascot.

items.title: Claude Code & Codex Buat Orang Awam: Bikin App Tanpa Jago Koding
items.description: A complete beginner's guide to building real apps, websites, and automations using Claude Code and OpenAI Codex—even if you've never written code from scratch.

items.title: Gimana Kalau AI Berontak? Fiksi vs. Realita
items.description: A 3-minute stickman documentary separating Hollywood sci-fi rebellion tropes from how modern AI alignment, reward hacking, and autonomous agent risks actually work in reality.

items.title: Apa Itu LLM? Cara Kerja Otak di Balik AI
items.description: An illustrated stickman explainer on Large Language Models: how next-token prediction, massive training corpora, and pattern recognition let AI write, reason, and code.

items.title: Apa Itu Token di AI? Cara AI Membaca Kata
items.description: Why AI doesn't read whole words like humans do: how text is sliced into sub-word tokens, translated into numerical IDs, and priced by context window usage.

items.title: Seri AI Ep. 1: Kenapa AI Bisa Halusinasi?
items.description: Episode 1 of the Stickman AI Series: why language models confidently make up fake facts when predicting probable words without a grounding source.

items.title: Seri AI Ep. 2: Cara Prompting Biar AI Nggak Ngawur
items.description: Episode 2 of the Stickman AI Series: practical context, constraints, and verification habits that drastically reduce AI hallucinations in daily work.

items.title: Seri AI Ep. 3: Bedanya Chatbot Biasa vs. AI Agent
items.description: Episode 3 of the Stickman AI Series: how tool use, memory, and multi-step planning turn a passive text chatbot into an autonomous AI agent.

items.title: Apa Itu Open Source? Ibarat Main Lego Bareng
items.description: A bite-sized visual analogy explaining open-source software as a shared Lego blueprint that anyone in the world can inspect, remix, and improve together.

items.title: Lisensi MIT vs. GPL: Dua Resep Gratis, Beda Aturan
items.description: Comparing permissive MIT licensing vs. copyleft GPL licensing through a kitchen recipe analogy: what you can close-source and what must stay open.

items.title: Flappy Bird (2013): Game $50K/Hari yang Dihapus Penciptanya
items.description: How Dong Nguyen built Flappy Bird in a single weekend in Hanoi, watched it hit #1 globally earning $50,000/day in ad revenue, and deleted it from the App Store out of guilt.

items.title: Sejarah SimSimi (2002): Chatbot Kuning Pelopor Era AI
items.description: Long before ChatGPT, a quirky yellow Korean chatbot launched in 2002 learned slang directly from millions of users—showing both the magic and chaos of crowd-trained chat.

items.title: Kenapa Hampir Semua Video Musik di YouTube Ada Nama VEVO?
items.description: Why Universal, Sony, and EMI teamed up in December 2008 to create VEVO rather than suing YouTube—turning music videos into an ad-revenue powerhouse.

items.title: Misteri Kaset PS1 Warna Hitam ke Era Pre-Order Digital
items.description: Why original PlayStation 1 discs were dyed jet-black, how physical game distribution evolved into digital pre-orders, and why gamers used to buy finished discs on day one.

items.title: Player Select: Kenalin Jeffry (@orpheuskaze)
items.description: An arcade character-select intro to @orpheuskaze: bridging Indonesian and English crypto/AI communities through clear storytelling, animated explainers, and hands-on builders' guides.

items.title: Dari Mesin Babbage 1837 ke Alan Turing & Komputer Modern
items.description: Tracing the lineage of modern computing from Charles Babbage's 1837 Analytical Engine and Ada Lovelace to Alan Turing's 1936 universal machine and wartime codebreaking.

items.title: Tier List AI Kalau Diajak Nongkrong & Bercanda
items.description: Ranking major AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, DeepSeek, Perplexity) by personality, humor, and vibe if you invited them to hang out at a coffee shop.

items.title: 4 AI Agents Battle: Meta Muse, Grok Bot, OpenAI & Claude
items.description: A head-to-head breakdown of four major AI agent ecosystems competing to automate workflows, browse the web, and execute complex multi-step tasks.

items.title: Apakah AI Bikin Kita Pelupa? Dari Plato 370 SM ke Riset MIT
items.description: Socrates once warned that writing would weaken human memory. Here is what modern cognitive research says about offloading thinking to AI—and how to use AI without losing sharpness.

items.title: Clickable Motion Dictionary: 120 Gerakan Gratis Buat Prompt AI
items.description: Stop prompting 'make a cool animation'—how to use an interactive dictionary of 120 named motion primitives so coding LLMs generate exact UI and video choreography.

items.title: Binance Agentic Wallet: Saat AI Punya Dompet Sendiri
items.description: How on-chain agentic wallets allow AI agents to hold funds, sign programmatic transactions under strict guardrails, and interact with DeFi protocols autonomously.

items.title: AI Heist Series: Ketika Grok & Bankr Punya Wallet On-Chain
items.description: A story-driven breakdown of what happens when social AI bots on X are connected to live on-chain wallets via Bankr—and how users try to social-engineer them.

items.title: Sahil Arora: Bubblemaps On-Chain Investigation (~$5M)
items.description: An English investigative breakdown of Bubblemaps' on-chain cluster analysis tracing celebrity memecoin launches and wallet outflows across Solana.

items.title: Meet Pocket (@pocketpad_io): Web3 Gaming & Wallet Companion
items.description: An English product showcase introducing Pocket (@pocketpad_io), an early-alpha consumer and gaming companion designed to make on-chain interactions feel effortless.

items.title: Dari Juara Dota 2 TI5 (UNiVeRsE) Jadi AI Developer
items.description: How Saahil 'UNiVeRsE' Arora—author of the famous $6 Million Echo Slam at The International 2015—retired from pro Dota 2 and reinvented himself as a software & AI builder.

items.title: Ex-Pro Dota 2 ke Developer Part 2: Joakim 'Akke' Akterhall
items.description: Part 2 of the Ex-Pro to Developer series: how TI3 champion Joakim 'Akke' Akterhall balanced competitive esports with a computer science degree and game studio career.

items.title: Kisah Changpeng Zhao (CZ): Dari Jiangsu 1977 ke Binance
items.description: The biography of Changpeng Zhao (CZ): immigrating to Vancouver, flipping burgers at McDonald's, building high-frequency trading systems, selling his apartment for Bitcoin, and launching Binance.

items.title: Davinci Jeremie (Mei 2013): Video 'Beli $1 Bitcoin' Saat $116
items.description: Looking back at Davinci Jeremie's iconic May 2013 YouTube plea urging viewers to spend just $1 on a lottery ticket called Bitcoin when BTC traded at $116.

items.title: Oscar Darmawan: Dari Pondok Media Semarang 2007 ke Indodax
items.description: How Oscar Darmawan started from a modest web agency in Semarang in 2007 to co-founding Bitcoin.co.id (now Indodax), Indonesia's earliest crypto exchange.

items.title: Crypto Bukan Cuma Trading: 6 Pintu Karier & Ekosistem Web3
items.description: Why crypto is much wider than price charts: exploring stablecoin payments ($302B+), developer tooling, research, content creation, community ops, and non-trading Web3 roles.

items.title: Kenapa Koin Meme Bisa Naik Cuma Karena Komunitas & Hype?
items.description: A stickman breakdown of attention economics in memecoins: how social coordination, liquidity depth, and narrative velocity drive price—and why late entrants bear the risk.

items.title: Series Memecoin Part 1: Perjalanan Trenching di On-Chain
items.description: Part 1 of the on-chain memecoin series: lessons learned from the trenches, tracking wallet flows, managing position sizing, and surviving high-volatility cycles.

items.title: IDX & MSCI Indonesia: Reformasi Pasar & Arus Modal Global
items.description: An explainer on how MSCI global index weightings work, why foreign institutional capital tracks them, and what Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) reforms mean for investors.

items.title: 214.000 Aktivitas Ancaman Siber: Deteksi vs. Pembobolan
items.description: Clarifying cybersecurity telemetry in digital banking: the difference between 214,000 automated threat detections blocked at the perimeter vs. an actual data breach.

items.title: Semua Dimulai dari PHP: Sejarah Web & Keamanan Aplikasi
items.description: From Rasmus Lerdorf's 1994 Personal Home Page scripts to modern web security: how early dynamic websites worked and why input validation still matters today.

items.title: Bridgeplay: Main Game Windows di Steam Mac secara Open-Source
items.description: How open-source translation layers let Apple Silicon Mac users run Windows-only Steam games smoothly without dual-booting or paying for heavyweight VMs.

items.title: VibeYourTV (CleanYourTV): Sulap Android TV Jadi Bersih
items.description: How to replace cluttered, ad-heavy smart TV home screens with a minimal, distraction-free launcher experience inspired by Apple TV.

items.title: Revo (Linked Horizon): Sosok di Balik Lagu Attack on Titan
items.description: The story of Japanese composer Revo (Sound Horizon / Linked Horizon) and how he crafted the symphonic rock anthems that defined Attack on Titan.
